title: 1993 LS Swap (6.0L LQ4 and built 4L60e)
transmission: Built 4L60E Stage 2 (rated 450hp/500 lb-ft) via Mark's MFK1195AE6 adapter
ai_summary: 1993 FZJ80 swapped with a low-mileage (~40,000 mi) 6.0L LQ4 paired to a built 4L60E Stage 2 transmission, using a Mark's MFK1195AE6 adapter to the retained factory HF2A transfer case. No dyno figures were reported; the build documents mostly exhaust and header fitment troubleshooting.

complications.detail: Old rusted exhaust hangers had to be cut off; Hooker headers (PN 2312HKR) had uneven gasket sealing from a flange design change and were replaced by the manufacturer
Vehicle speed sensor from the original tailshaft required modification to fit the Mark's adapter
